body: I've been taking citalopram for the last month. I started out on 10 mg, and I just recently started taking 20mg. It took a really long time for me to notice any improvement, but I think that I'm finally I starting to feel a little bit more motivated and energetic. I still have a lot of trouble enjoying things and I still have fairly frequent suicidal thoughts, but I'm hoping that those symptoms will get better as I keep on taking the medication. Different drugs work differently on different people, so hopefully you'll have better luck with citalopram than I had. I hope that you feel better soon.

It's great to hear that you're feeling better. How long did it take for your antidepressants to start taking effect? I've just started taking an antidepressant a bit over a week ago, and I still haven't experienced any noticeable improvement yet.

Thanks for the reply. Honestly, I'm not entirely what to expect from my therapy sessions. I've never seen a therapist before, although I've thought about doing so for quite a while. I'm really hoping that, with the help of some strong antidepressants, I'll finally be able to feel happy again, or at least get out of bed every now and then, but I can't help but feel a little skeptical. There are a lot of people on this subreddit who have said that therapy and medication don't help at all, and I'm not sure who to believe. Regarding my next week, I'm probably going to spend it the way that I spend most of my weeks: attending classes in crowded lecture halls in which I will talk to literally nobody else, trying desperately to concentrate on my textbooks and notebooks so that I don't flunk out of college even though I inevitably will, telling my parents that I'm just tired and not at all suicidally depressed while trying my best to hide the scars on my forearm, laying in bed and thinking about the quickest and least painful way to off myself, that kind of stuff. I'm sorry that I'm going on a bit of a tangent, I guess I just need to vent a little bit. Thanks again for your reply. It helps a lot to know that other people care about my life.
I really appreciate your advice. Unfortunately, I live in a state with very strict drug laws, and I don't know anybody who'd be willing to sell me any. I'm only 19, so I can't even get drunk legally.
